Introduction

Nana is a Japanese singer under F&F Entertainment. She is a former member of the Japanese girl group PRIKIL and is a member of the South Korean project girl group UNIS.

She is best known for participating in the Japanese survival show Who Is Princess? and South Korean survival show Universe Ticket.

On December 30, 2023, she represented Universe Ticket at the SBS Entertainment Awards alongside seven other contestants. They performed "Come With Me?" and "Smoke" (with Dynamic Duo).
